title: Research sprint goal: Tool speed and cache hygiene: eval three times faster, check-trailers in one git log, _cache pruned
goal: Research only what the goal's packs lack (rag.py pack, 2026-10-09): (1) sqlite3 VACUUM and auto_vacuum (INCREMENTAL or FULL) as the stdlib sqlite3 module runs them, when VACUUM is refused (inside a transaction, the isolation_level the module opens with) and what each reclaims after DELETE, weak in python/stdlib-sqlite3-csv.md; (2) cProfile and pstats: the fields of a pstats.Stats().stats entry (call counts, primitive calls) and how runpy or exec under a profiler is counted, none in the kb. The git log trailers format for a range (gitlab/git-trailers-and-hooks.md:21, :34, :56) packs good and needs no research. Write the facts to those topics through /kb-research with official sources and gap entries for what the sources do not state.
